name: vx-twitter-utils
description: Copy the sanitized, embed fixed link in one click. Domain modifiable!
author: Lucky2307

scripts.postinstall: rm -rf utils && mkdir utils && cp node_modules/webextension-polyfill/dist/browser-polyfill.min.js utils/
scripts.build: mkdir vx-twitter-share; mkdir build; cp ./manifest.json vx-twitter-share/ -r; cp images vx-twitter-share/ -r; cp scripts vx-twitter-share/ -r; cp options vx-twitter-share/ -r; cp utils vx-twitter-share/ -r
